name: Takamura Seiji
source:
"But one star is just a shining point. You can't tell which star it is."

An old man in his 70s who is always observing astronomical objects on the river bed. He says he's looking for an invisible star...?

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/nitousei/]official website[/url]]
